These are factual and topical overlaps, not concrete drafting templates for the child's structure or operative scheme.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"February 1, 1955 is hereby determined ... as the date prior to which persons serving in the active service in the armed forces of the United States on or after June 27, 1950, must have so served","parent_excerpt":"during any period between June 27, 1950, inclusive, and a terminal date to be fixed by the Secretary of Defense","explanation":"C01 shares the Korean-service start date and the concept of a terminal eligibility date, but uses different authority and machinery for a single military medal."},{"child_excerpt":"by reason of service on or after June 27, 1950","parent_excerpt":"if any part of that period of service has been performed after June 27, 1950","explanation":"C17 uses the same conflict-linked date for medal eligibility, but does not resemble the child's repeated statutory terminal-date determinations."},{"child_excerpt":"persons serving in the active service in the armed forces of the United States on or after June 27, 1950","parent_excerpt":"after serving in active status for not less than one year subsequent to June 25, 1950","explanation":"C20 similarly conditions legal relief on Korean-era armed service, but its pardon mechanism and drafting structure are materially different."}]}
